Finish the film "The Moonwinder" with the workflow "H3 Keyframe Chain (Comfort)". Read its guide first (describe_workflow). Keyframes already rendered at 1376x768: K1 = A:\Ai projects\Comfort\out\moonwind_k1\01-1_colossal-clockwork-moon.png, K2 = A:\Ai projects\Comfort\out\moonwind_k2\01-1_lone-traveler-arriving.png, K3 = A:\Ai projects\Comfort\out\moonwind_k3\01-1_traveler-kneeling-at.png, K4 = A:\Ai projects\Comfort\out\moonwind_k4\01-1_looking-up-at.png, K4b = A:\Ai projects\Comfort\out\moonwind_k4b\01-1_traveler-kneeling-at.png.

Step 1: generate K5 at size 1376x768 with name moonwind_k5 and this exact prompt: "A colossal clockwork moon blazing awake over a night desert where every sand ripple glows with flowing gold light, stylized fantasy illustration with flat layered shapes and fine gold filigree linework, swirling scroll-shaped clouds and dunes drawn with fine wavy ripple lines. Wide 16:9 high view from behind and above: on the crest of a dune left of centre stands a gnarled tree with a flat dark canopy and gold veins of light in its trunk, and beside it a small traveler in a long pale sand-coloured hooded cloak stands looking up, the tall brass key still standing in a brass keyhole plate at the roots. Lines of gold light race outward from the tree through every ripple of the dunes like flowing water, and a winding stream shines gold. The huge moon fills the upper half, its cream clock face with roman numerals and glowing gold gears turning. Cream scroll clouds, dark starry sky with purple-gold streaks, no text."

Step 2: render 5 clips with run_workflow "H3 Keyframe Chain (Comfort)", n 1, seed random: images pic1.image = first keyframe and pic2.image = last keyframe; set ref.length and ref.prompt. Names moonwind_c1 to moonwind_c5.
- c1: K1 to K2, ref.length 209. She walks up the dune crest toward the tree and stops beside it. The camera glides forward and lowers behind her on the same axis; the moon grows larger; stars twinkle, clouds drift.
- c2: K2 to K3, ref.length 243. She kneels at the roots, brushes sand from a brass keyhole plate against the trunk, raises the giant key and seats its shaft in the keyhole, gripping the bow above her head. The camera pushes in and lowers behind her right shoulder.
- c3: K3 to K4, ref.length 175. She turns the key with a heavy clank; gold light runs up the roots and trunk; the camera tilts up following the light to the moon; the moon's face brightens from dark blue to glowing cream, its gears start turning, and its own great key turns in step with hers.
- c4: K4 to K4b, ref.length 158. The gears turn faster and gold sparks drift down; the camera tilts back down and pulls back a little to her at the keyhole; gold light starts pouring out of the keyhole into the sand.
- c5: K4b to K5, ref.length 277. She rises and steps back beside the tree; the gold light races out through every sand ripple like flowing water across the desert; the camera cranes up and pulls back high in one continuous move.

Every clip prompt: the official REF2VA format in the guide, one continuous [Shot 1] with no cut, the shot begins from <Picture 1> and ends on <Picture 2>. Define <Subject 1> = the traveler (long pale sand-coloured hooded cloak, hood up, tall ornate brass key with a looped bow), <Subject 2> = the style (stylized fantasy illustration, flat layered shapes, fine gold filigree linework, scroll-shaped clouds, sand drawn with fine wavy ripple lines), plus the <Picture 1> first frame and <Picture 2> last frame lines. overall_soundscape: desert wind, hissing sand, footsteps, the metal clank of the key, and a deep clockwork ratchet and ticking from the sky that grows as the moon wakes. non_diegetic_music: N/A. Do not re-roll anything. When done, list the output file of each clip.
